title: Retrieve after a scan started in Squid's GUI
body: If a plate is already at Squid and the user requests retrieval after acquisition, use plan_squid_retrieval. This binds the current observed run and experiment IDs, whether still running or already successfully completed, then waits, returns the physical stage to the accepted loading position, and retrieves the plate to robot Home. It does not repeat calibration, drop-off, imaging, or native microscope homing. One Yes authorizes the entire continuation. Completion after a successful standalone drop-off proactively offers this plan but does not move without confirmation. A prior full automatic experiment already includes its authorized retrieval. Never infer that no acquisition exists from an identifier mismatch; get_squid_status without an ID reads the current job. A verified completion receipt can be revalidated after console reload against the same native session/current terminal job, but never authorizes motion itself. Failures, changed jobs, lost connection or stage position mismatch stop progression.
source: Observed GUI acquisition completion and missing continuation diagnosed; squid_retrieval.py, 2026-10-24

title: Complete Hamilton and Squid loop with one confirmation
body: For the established SAME-plate workflow use plan_lab_roundtrip, not the old plan_experiment preview. Start with a held plate at Home, or add full calibration pickup once at the beginning. Deliver to Hamilton and park Home; start the selected dispensing protocol and wait for that exact job; retrieve via Home, deliver to Squid and park Home; image using current selected settings, wait for that exact acquisition, return the Squid stage to its accepted loading position, retrieve via Home and deliver back to Hamilton. Finish every cycle with the plate at Hamilton and arm Home. Repeat exactly N cycles. One inline Yes or typed Yes authorizes the displayed complete plan; No cancels it. Existing accepted routes and station handling are used, with no model-generated coordinates. Stop on fault or uncertain completion, without automatic retries. Check live capabilities: Hamilton bridge is disabled/Coming Soon and automatic loaded Hamilton handling needs recorded acceptance. Do not claim a physical end-to-end experiment is commissioned merely because offline tests pass. Current Squid XYZ is physical and camera simulated. This supersedes the older repeated-experiment template for this same-plate loop only.
